title: KY Bush sitao (KY Bush F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: KY Bush sitao is an F1 hybrid (per Harbest) sitao variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: KY Bush sitao is an F1 hybrid (per Harbest) sitao variety, also sold or known as KY Bush F1. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Harbest Agribusiness.

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where KY Bush sitao is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for KY Bush F1, this is the same sitao. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sitao variety finder](/crop-varieties/sitao), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).
Key facts about KY Bush sitao

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** About 50 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Slender stringless light green pods, about 25 to 30 cm.
Bush type (dwarf, about 50 cm tall, well branched, no trellis).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the bush sitao in Harbest's current seed catalogue, company listing is the only evidence found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual sitao on the same ground.
Where and when to plant KY Bush sitao

Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is KY Bush F1 the same as KY Bush?
items.a: Yes. KY Bush F1 is another name for KY Bush. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of KY Bush?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
